character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A boss creature for a 1990s American shopping mall horror roguelite: the Loss Prevention Manager, corrupted. A large imposing humanoid in the remains of a 1990s mall security uniform: a dark navy jacket with a blank shoulder patch containing NO lettering, a peaked uniform cap, and a duty belt carrying a radio and a ring of keys. The body has grown too large and asymmetric: one shoulder is massively swollen with a fused mass of small dead CRT security monitors, cables run up the neck into the jaw, the jaw is distended, and one eye is clouded white. Still clearly a mall security manager underneath. POSTURE: standing tall and broad with the arms held out from the body, noticeably bigger than a normal person. CRITICAL: the navy uniform, peaked cap and duty belt keep the retail security role recognisable. STYLE: detailed late-SNES pixel art, crisp hard pixels, clean deliberate clusters, selective outlines, minimal dithering, no anti-aliasing, no blur. LIGHTING: neutral overhead fluorescent mall lighting. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos anywhere.
